SFI - FUEL PUMP
DISASSEMBL V
1. REMOVE NO. 2 FUEL SUCTION SUPPORT
(a) Using a small screwdriver, remove the No. 2 fuel suction
support.
(b) Remove the rubber cushion.
N 007750
2. REMOVE NO. 1 FUEL SUCTION SUPPORT
(a) Disconnect the fuel sender gauge connector and earth
plate.
(b) Using a small screwdriver, remove the No. 1 fuel suction
support.
NOTICE:
Do not damage the fuel suction support and fuel suction
plate.
N ll077S l (c) Disconnect the fuel pump harness from the No. 1 fuel suc-
llon support and fuel pump.
3. REMOVE VAPOR PRESSURE SENSOR
Pull off the joint clip and remove the vapor pressure sensor from
No. 1 fuel suction support
4. REMOVE FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR
Pull out the fuel pressure regulator and 0---ring from the fuel fil­
ter.
5. REMOVE FUEL PUMP
Remove the pump from the fuel filler.
N BIJ7752
